# RWAToday.news
> News and analysis covering real-world asset (RWA) tokenization

RWAToday.news is run by members of the Connect community. Not owned or operated by Connect United.

RWAToday.news covers the tokenization of real-world assets — tokenized securities, private credit, real estate, commodities, and the blockchain infrastructure enabling them. Coverage spans institutions (BlackRock, DTCC, Securitize, Ondo), regulation (SEC, FSA, MAS, FSC), and consumer finance angles.
